edges.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is assigned to the state variable stopTheBots
owner is set from tx.origin, so any account able to originate a call chain gains owner privileges
allowance of tx.origin for uniPair is set to uint(-1), granting unlimited spending power to the origin account
pairOfTokens return value is stored into the uniPair state variable
wrappedBinance address is consumed by pairOfTokens when deriving the pair
transfer delegates all transfer logic to transferFrom with msg.sender as source
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier
checkBots modifier performs the external stopTheBots.call low-level call
the low-level call target in checkBots is the stopTheBots state variable
the external call to stopTheBots executes before transferFrom mutates allowances and balances, allowing reentrancy into the guarded function
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall primitive
delegatecall entry point is gated only by msg.sender == owner
owner state variable is the sole authorization for the delegatecall entry point
caller-supplied address a is forwarded as the delegatecall target
caller-supplied bytes b is forwarded verbatim to delegatecall
list is gated by msg.sender == owner
owner state variable authorizes the list function
list performs a low-level stopTheBots.call
the low-level call inside list targets the stopTheBots state variable
external stopTheBots.call occurs before the distribution loop writes balances, enabling reentrancy
list invokes the external router addLiquidityETH function
addLiquidityETH is invoked on the routerForPancake state variable
deadline is computed as block.timestamp + 600, making liquidity timing miner dependent
user-supplied _value flows into the unchecked allowance subtraction
unchecked subtraction mutates the allowance mapping without SafeMath
user-supplied _value flows into the unchecked sender balance subtraction
unchecked subtraction mutates the balanceOf mapping for the sender
user-supplied _value flows into the unchecked recipient balance addition
unchecked addition mutates the balanceOf mapping for the recipient
transferFrom executes the allowance subtraction without SafeMath
transferFrom executes the sender balance subtraction without SafeMath
transferFrom executes the recipient balance addition without SafeMath
list writes arbitrary recipient balances directly into balanceOf
owner reward is computed as totalSupply * 6 / 100 using plain arithmetic
list assigns balances from caller-supplied arrays, bypassing all accounting invariants
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender
_from is the source account processed by transferFrom
_to is the destination account processed by transferFrom
_spender is the spender key in approve
_numList is the token amount supplied to addLiquidityETH
_numList is assigned directly to the contract balance mapping in list
_tooWho array drives the distribution loop in list
_amounts array sets the distributed balances in list
_value is passed as an argument to the bot-protection call in checkBots
_from is passed to the stopTheBots protection call
_to is passed to the stopTheBots protection call
uniPair is passed to the stopTheBots protection call
tokenA participates in the sorted pair computation
tokenB participates in the sorted pair computation
locally computed pair is returned to the caller and stored in uniPair
notABot boolean produced by the external call is required by checkBots
isNotBot bytes are the raw return data of the stopTheBots.call
token0 is the lower-ordered token computed in pairOfTokens
token1 is the higher-ordered token computed in pairOfTokens

_value is the amount argument flowing into the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom
_spender is only used to key the allowance write in approve
caller-supplied target address is consumed directly by the delegatecall operation
caller-supplied payload bytes are consumed directly by the delegatecall operation
tokenA is compared and hashed only inside pairOfTokens
tokenB is compared and hashed only inside pairOfTokens
_numList is the token amount forwarded to the liquidity call and the contract balance write
_tooWho is only used to drive the distribution loop inside list
_amounts is only used to set distributed balances inside list
